clips.title: The story
paras: At Bandarion Keep, defenders face threats from the coast and the woodland. The outpost near the Whispering Forest is named for Garek Bandarion and tied to Tyr's Watch.

Bandarion Keep stands near the Whispering Forest in western Tirisfal Glades. Named for Garek Bandarion, the stronghold is closely tied to Tyr's Watch. Quartermaster Jorin Croge works to keep the garrison supplied, though the keep lies far from the courtyards of the Undercity.

Danger reaches Bandarion Keep from several directions. Vile Fin murlocs raid along nearby waters, the Scarlet Crusade probes with skirmishes, and mindless Scourge thralls wander through the gloom. Some paladins have struggled to adjust to their unlife as Forsaken and succumbed to madness. They turn their weapons against their own kindred.
